title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164 Sec. 94G, and the Company's tariff M.D.P.U. 115, for approval by the Department of a change in the Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customer pursuant to meter readings in the months of December 1991 and January, February 1992. Application is also made for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilties with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners participating: Yardley, Chairman, Kates-Garnick and Webster (91-4E).
Transcript received of hearing on 11/20/91. Volume 1, 21 pages. Original & 1.
Testimony of Arthur F. Sullivan (PPCA Factor E-5R M-13).
Company's schedules in support of a fuel cost adjustment factor applicable December 1991 - February 1992. By: Arthur F. Sullivan. (91-43).
Hearing notice issued to be held at Saltonstall, Wednesday, November 20, 1991 at 1:30 p.m (91-4D).
